Lemma
[Trace criterion in dimension three] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0197 1. ch31:31.9\group Hyperbolic isometries

For $[M]\in \operatorname {PSL}(2,\mathbb C)$, represented by $M\in \operatorname {SL}(2,\mathbb C)\setminus \{ \pm I\} $, the class is elliptic iff $\operatorname {tr}M\in (-2,2)$, parabolic iff $\operatorname {tr}M=\pm 2$, and hyperbolic iff the trace is real with absolute value greater than two or is nonreal. An element fixing infinity acts by $(z,t)\mapsto (a^2z+ab,|a|^2t)$.
